title: Guaranteed Scaled Commitment and Autoscale Guardrails
creator: Asha Patel
description: Deliver a simplified, enterprise-friendly reserved GPU offering that combines guaranteed throughput bands with well-defined autoscale guardrails and burst credits. Objectives: (1) create 3 commitment tiers with clear throughput guarantees and predictable billing; (2) define autoscale behavior and grace windows to allow safe burst above reserved capacity with controlled overage mechanics; (3) align SLA tiers (latency p50/p95 targets and uptime) to commitment levels; (4) document contract language and complete a security questionnaire template for enterprise procurement. This ticket covers product definitions, pricing experiments, contract Q&A, sales playbook inputs, and operational runbooks for Dedicated capacity launches.
acceptance_criteria: SKU page drafted and reviewed by legal and sales
Pricing matrix validated against cost model and CFO sign-off
Autoscale policy implemented in staging with rollout toggle
Contract clause language for burst/overage and preemption grace approved
Security questionnaire (SQ) template completed and sample responses prepared
rollout_plan: Week 1: Finalize tier definitions + pricing experiments (A/B pricing cells)
Week 2: Legal prepares contract language and SQ template; Sales reviews playbook
Week 3: Engineering implements autoscale guardrail flags and metrics
Week 4: Pilot with 3 existing enterprise customers, gather telemetry and billing data
Week 6: Iterate pricing and SLA language, open limited public beta for new Dedicated signups
negotiation_notes: Primary levers: committed GPU-hours, guaranteed throughput lanes, burst credits, preemption grace window
Consider allowing transfer of unused committed capacity between regions with 30% fee
Offer a 12-month discount ladder for multi-year commitments, but reserve right to rebalance pricing after 24 months
Sales asked for an ‘enterprise concierge’ add-on that guarantees faster capacity scaling for strategic accounts
estimated_revenue_impact: $1.2M ARR (conservative) - $3.8M ARR (upside) based on pilot traction and expected mid-market conversions
risk_register: Risk: Autoscale above reserved capacity increases cost without commensurate revenue. Mitigation: implement tokenized burst credits and configurable burst caps per customer.
Risk: Complex SLAs confuse sales and legal. Mitigation: create 1-page SLA summary and decision matrix for contract negotiators.
Risk: Security questionnaire responses require engineering time. Mitigation: prepare canned responses and an SQ owner in Solutions Engineering.
Risk: Overlap with existing reserved offerings. Mitigation: sunset rarely used legacy SKUs and map customers to new bands via migration credits
day0_goals: Publish new Dedicated SKU catalog entry
Add autoscale guardrail controls to console (UI and API) with default conservative settings
Ship sales playbook and contract language templates
Prepare 3 pilot agreements and internal billing simulation for legal/finance review
qa_checklist: Billing simulation completes for 100k token/day synthetic workload
Autoscale toggles respect tenant-level burst caps and trigger expected alerts
SLA page renders correct p50/p95 latency targets per tier
Security questionnaire sample responses reviewed by Security team
